observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates step-by-step techniques outdoors, breaking down the basis, half twist, and full twist with another person assisting. He speaks directly to the camera and uses title cards to introduce each move.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction and preview of jumpstyle dancing
Teaching how to start the jump

steps_taught.name: The Basis
steps_taught.description: Kick right foot out twice, then left foot out and bring back

steps_taught.name: The Half Twist
steps_taught.description: Kick and twist 90 degrees left and right

steps_taught.name: The Full Twist
steps_taught.description: Do the half twist and finish with a 360 kick

steps_taught.name: The Knee Spin
steps_taught.description: Grab your knee when twisting backwards and kick it out

what_works: Clear title cards for each section
what_hinders: Audio is sometimes out of sync or voiceover style without close-up footwork
